facts.Program Type: Embodied AI / Robotics Founder Camp + Ecosystem
facts.Focus: Embodied AI, robotics and the related supply chain.
facts.Funding / Support: Startup services and supply-chain, customer and capital connections. MARS invests at early stages, but the camp does not publish standard investment amounts or equity terms.
facts.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Early Investment Exists / Standard Deal Not Public
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Embodied AI and robotics founders across the supply chain; current MARS Space camps are open to the relevant founder community.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.Eligibility Disclosure Status: Verified — Sector Public / Detailed Selection Criteria Not Public
facts.Format: Industry camp, founder community and industry and capital connections.
facts.On-site / Attendance: A three-day embodied AI camp took place in Suzhou Industrial Park in 2026. MARS Space continues industry camps and financing and supply-chain events. Cohort five is recruiting; the full schedule is not published.
facts.Duration: Short intensive camp and long-term community.
facts.International Founder: Primarily China robotics ecosystem; globalisation support is part of stated mission
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Status: Recruiting for MARS Embodied AI Founder Camp cohort five.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Recruitment continues for the 2026 MARS embodied AI camp; MARS Space is operating.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; primarily at the Early stage / existing founder teams stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: Foundshore: high-value for embodied AI/robotics, but do not display a fixed investment amount or equity because none is publicly standardized.
